jobs.title: Head of Sales Americas, Private Markets Data Solutions (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Eligible Location:
Canada- Fully Remote

CEPRES
is the leading and fastest growing digital data platform for private capital markets, encompassing portfolio management, investment due diligence, portfolio forecasting and market research and deal comps. Our clients include some of the World’s largest and most influential institutional investors (LPs) and asset managers (GPs), as well as many service providers such as banks, administrators, etc.

CEPRES
is headquartered in Munich with North American offices in New York, and Denver, Chicago and Toronto. Our team is incredibly diverse with over 20 nationalities globally. We value smart and innovative people who also work effectively in a team environment and who are global players.

The Role:

As the Head of Sales, Americas for CEPRES, you will be responsible for driving the sales strategy, execution, and management of the firm's private equity software and data offerings in the Americas. You will work closely with senior leadership and manage a sales team to identify new business opportunities, manage relationships with potential investors, and ensure the achievement of sales targets. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of private markets, working in the context of software and data solutions, especially for GP Investor Relations and Deal Teams, but also LPs and service providers, exceptional client-facing skills, and a proven ability to build and manage client relationships.

CEPRES
has built the world’s largest data network for private capital markets —where GPs can interact with and securely share their data with sovereign wealth funds, insurers, pension plans and others for mutual benefit and to enhance investment management and deal making in private markets.

What we need now is a leader to drive the market expansion in North America and substantially grow our market footprint. This is a player-coach mandate: you will lead the sales team and help them open new logos from across your network and lead the team to success and new business success through your leadership.

In this role, you will:

Set sales strategy
– working with senior leadership and the sales team to design and execute a sales strategy that drives new business and market growth.
Build and lead a team.
Develop, hire, and optimize a highly effective team of sales managers, BDRs and presales engineers who can effectively generate pipelines, engage prospects and close new business together.
Sales Pipeline –
operationally manage the team pipeline, ensuring proper planning, tracking and execution of sales activities and CRM hygiene to feed into global sales modelling.
Go-to-market strategy.
Optimize market segmentation, pricing models to win new business and leave room for larger deal upside, marketing strategies (in collaboration with marketing), etc.
Lead from the front.
Directly support the team
in meetings and through mentoring. Especially take on the most significant and enterprise level deals from end to end to ensure success.
Be an advocate.
Build relationships with industry influencers, be a champion for CEPRES in the market and help promote the brand and represent CEPRES at the industry's most important events.
Solution engineering.
Partner with Product and data services to ensure we can meet the market needs with input to the product roadmap. Ensure that we can meet the requirements to close new business that requires product enhancement, and any custom work is priced and sold correctly.
Interaction with Professional Services and Customer Success Management.
Operate a land, expand and retain approach to sales. Make sure we can deliver what we sell in collaboration with other teams and that client satisfaction is maintained and supports future upsell opportunities.

Requirements:

10–15+ years in sales or business development in financial services,
specifically successful selling software and data solutions. Candidates who began in consulting and moved into a sales or commercial role are equally welcome.
3–5+ years of experience in private markets.
In particular interacting with brand name GPs working with front office practitioners within Investor Relations and Deal Teams. An understanding of LPs and their demands is also a must.
5+ years' experience in sales leadership.
A proven track record managing successfully and multi-functional sales teams with numbers to back it up.
A personal closing record you can point to.
You have carried and delivered your own quota of brand names in financial services.
New-logo hunting instinct.
You can hunt from the front and show the path to your team to generate new pipeline —you focus on opening accounts to farming them.
Proven enterprise deal leadership.
You have closed complex, six- and seven-figure multi-year agreements with large financial entities and navigated complex legal, procurement, and IT challenges.
Outstanding presentation capabilities.
Experience presenting to an analyst or Chief Investment Officer and other stakeholders across procurement and IT, etc.
Executive communication.
You are persuasive in a boardroom, precise in a forecast review, and credible on a conference stage.
Real private markets knowledge.
CAIA level or equivalent knowledge of private markets concepts and investment needs

Benefits:

Enhanced Career in Private Markets
CEPRES is at the top of the food chain for private markets data and solutions and helping professionals in ways others haven’t even thought of. Be part of a unique growth story and take on an exciting, challenging role in a dynamic global environment.
Culture that Drives Success
We are powered by core values that foster an entrepreneurial spirit, drive results, and empower ownership. At our company, collaboration and mutual support is at the heart of everything we do. Transparency in company goals ensures you’re always part of the bigger picture.
Commitment to Our People
We care deeply about our team, offering outstanding benefits and opportunities to thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and international workplace
Compensation of Attractive Package
that reflects your skills, contributions, and growth potential.

At CEPRES, we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We celebrate diversity and encourage applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply.

Industries

jobs.company: Meridia Recruitment Solutions, a KBRS Company
jobs.title: Deputy Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Deputy Chief Financial Officer

Prince Rupert, BC
Reference # AC - 7380

Meridia Recruitment Solutions has partnered with the Prince Rupert Port Authority (PRPA) to recruit a Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Deputy CFO) to join their leadership team.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Deputy CFO will provide leadership across accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis, procurement, financial reporting, and capital finance. This role will play a key part in supporting strategic decision-making, overseeing day-to-day financial operations, and ensuring the organization maintains strong financial management, governance, and reporting practices.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes in support of organizational priorities and capital investment plans.
• Prepare financial analysis, business cases, and investment models to support executive and Board decision-making.
• Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, financing arrangements, and banking relationships.
• Provide financial oversight of capital projects and procurement activities, ensuring effective budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls.
• Lead the preparation of accurate and timely IFRS-compliant financial statements and management reporting.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to financial systems, reporting processes, internal controls, and finance operations.
• Coordinate the annual external audit process and ensure compliance with regulatory, taxation, and reporting requirements.
• Prepare materials and reporting for the Executive Leadership Team, Audit Committee, and Board of Directors.
• Partner with leaders across the organization to support budgeting, resource allocation, and operational decision-making.
• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

YOUR REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
• CPA designation required; MBA or other advanced business or finance education considered an asset.
• 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including 5 years of experience in a senior finance role with responsibility for financial planning, reporting, treasury, and governance.
• Experience supporting Boards of Directors, Audit Committees, and senior executive leadership teams.

KEY SKILLS & CHARACTERISTICS

• Strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, treasury management, internal controls, and financial planning practices.
• Demonstrated success improving finance functions, systems, processes, and reporting capabilities.
• Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills.
• Experience within infrastructure, transportation, marine, logistics, public sector, or other capital-intensive industries would be considered an asset.
• Ability to obtain and maintain Transport Canada Security Clearance.

This is a current vacancy; salary range is $189,000 - $245,000.

To express interest in this opportunity, please click on the "Apply Now" button below.

For more information, please contact Adam Creaghan, Partner, at acreaghan@kbrs.ca or 647-336-1416 or Lauren MacDonald, Recruitment Specialist, at laurenmacdonald@kbrs.ca or 902-407-1427. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let Lauren know.

Meridia Recruitment Solutions connects leading organizations with top talent by building strong relationships and creating ideal matches with candidates because we are only successful when you are.

We appreciate your interest in this opportunity. To learn more about Meridia Recruitment Solutions, our job opportunities, and career advice, we invite you to explore our site and subscribe for career alerts.

jobs.title: Finance Director (6 month contract)
jobs.description:
This is a 6 month contract with permanent potential at the end of the contract

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.
Assist in preparing for audits, including providing necessary documentation for revenue and payroll audits.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding payroll and revenue recognition.

Process Improvement:
Continuously assess and improve payroll and revenue recognition processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline payroll processing and financial reporting.
Collaborate with IT and software vendors to maintain and optimize payroll and accounting systems.

Skills
Exceptional attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.).

About You

CPA or other relevant certifications preferred.
5+ years of experience in accounting or finance, with a focus on IFRS reporting.
Strong knowledge of IFRS
and experience preparing and reviewing complex financial statements and disclosures.
Experience leading external audits and working effectively with external auditors and other key stakeholders.
Proven experience managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial reporting processes
.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 or equivalent).
Solid understanding of accounting principles and regulatory requirements

When referencing this job, quote #470118.
